subject: Initial MAP and acceptance milestones for Cartograph pilot
messages:
From: Alex Moreno <alex@cartograph.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: eng@cartograph.ai
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot MAP: Cartograph x Redwood — aligning milestones

Marissa,

Great to meet on the call earlier — per our conversation the execs want a clear 30/60 acceptance plan we can present internally. I'm attaching a short requirements doc (PDF) that lists the hard constraints: SSO, data retention, and max token cost targets.

Can you share a MAP template and a quick draft we can review with our infra lead (cc'd)? Key asks from our side:
- Pilot kickoff: target week of Sep 6
- Workloads: 3 model endpoints, 2 stress test runs
- Acceptance criteria: latency < 150ms P95, embedded vectors for search within 24 hrs

If you can send a template and a proposed milestone timeline, we'll try to lock down sponsor approval this week.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Moreno
Head of ML Platforms
Cartograph Labs

Attachments: Cartograph_pilot_requirements.pdf (PDF, 1 page)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Moreno <alex@cartograph.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot MAP: Cartograph x Redwood — aligning milestones

Alex — thanks for the clear ask and the requirements doc. I've attached our MAP template (Google Doc link below) and sketched an initial 30/60 acceptance timeline. High-level proposal:

Week 0 (prep)
- NDA + security kickoff (SSO scope)
- Test data handoff checklist

Week 1–2 (integration)
- Model endpoints deployed to dedicated pilot pool
- Connection testing and KV/prefix caching validation

Week 3–4 (validation)
- 2 stress runs, gradational load test
- Latency and throughput baselining (P95)

Week 5–8 (acceptance)
- Feature acceptance by product owners
- Final acceptance signoff and runbook handover

I put Ben and Jasmine on cc to coordinate the kickoff and technical agenda. Link to editable doc: https://drive.google.com/open?id=redwood-map-cartograph-v1 (redwood_map_template_v1.gdoc)

Next steps:
1) Can you confirm sponsors and the Sep 6 kickoff window?
2) Provide SSO contact + security questionnaire owner (we'll route the SOC2 questionnaire)

I'll follow up with a short slide deck for the kickoff.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_map_template_v1.gdoc (link)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Moreno <alex@cartograph.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot MAP: Cartograph x Redwood — aligning milestones

Alex / Marissa — adding a few practical milestones and owners so the MAP is actionable:

- Owner: infra lead (Cartograph) — provide SSO details, test identity space (by Aug 27)
- Owner: Ben (Redwood infra) — provisioning dedicated pilot pool (by Sep 3)
- Owner: Jasmine (Redwood SRE) — coordinate load test window and guardrails (Sep 14–16)

Suggested acceptance metrics (to include in MAP):
- Latency P95 <= 150ms on pilot pool with 95th percentile load
- Token cost delta < 1.2x baseline for equivalent throughput
- Embedding indexing latency < 24 hours

I've also attached a short kickoff agenda (slides) I'll use during the Sep 6 call. Feel free to edit the doc to add other stakeholders.

Ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
Attachment: technical-kickoff-agenda.gslides

Thanks all — sponsor confirmed (VP of infra). Quick updates and questions:

- Sep 6 kickoff: confirmed on our side, please block 60 minutes (we need the security touchpoint in first 15).
- Security: our security team will send the standard questionnaire (cc'd). Can Redwood assign a contact for SOC2 artifact collection?
- SSO: we use Okta; I will share a contact by EOD Monday.

I updated the requirements PDF with a short note about data retention expectations (attached). We're comfortable with the proposed milestones but would like a short rollback/contingency line in the MAP in case perf targets are missed during stress runs.

Alex
Alex Moreno
Head of ML Platforms, Cartograph Labs

Attachments: Cartograph_pilot_requirements_v2.pdf
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>

Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot MAP: Cartograph x Redwood — aligning milestones

Alex — appreciate the quick confirm. Action items from Redwood side ahead of Sep 6 kickoff:

- Jasmine (SRE) will be primary contact for load tests and contingency plan (jasmine_liu@redwood.ai)
- Ben will provision the pilot pool and share access creds for test endpoints by Sep 2
- Marissa will publish the MAP draft in the doc and tag owners/acceptance gates (done by Aug 24)
- Redwood security engineer will reach out re: SOC2 artifacts and a short evidence bundle (expected turnaround 3–5 business days)

Proposed contingency blurb for MAP: If P95 exceeds 200ms in two consecutive stress runs, rollback to read-only model variant and execute perf tuning playbook; regroup and extend validation window by 1 week.

I'll add the contingency wording to the MAP doc now and send a calendar invite for Sep 6 — please accept if the time works.

—Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
SRE, Redwood Inference
